gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 787.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Tai Cheong Street running south-eastwards for a distance of approximately 220 m and ending at its junction with Tai On Street as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. HH 3688. Proposed Name: HONG CHEUNG STREET. Chinese Version: 康祥街.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點與大祥街連接，向東南伸展約二二〇米，終點與太安街連接，其位置在 HH 3688 號圖則內用粉紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 787.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with thoroughfare shown coloured pink on Drawing No. HH 3688 and running south-westwards for a distance of approximately 52 m as shown coloured green on the said drawing. Proposed Name: SHUN FU STREET. Chinese Version: 順富街.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路線為盡頭路，起點與 HH 3688 號圖則內用粉紅色標明之街道連接，向西南伸展約五十二米，其位置在圖則內用綠色標明。
